cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Hello. Do you mind if I ask you some questions about your journey today?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: We're doing a customer satisfaction survey.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: Yes. OK. I've got about ten minutes before my train home leaves. I'm on a day trip.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Great. Thank you. So first of all, could you tell me your name?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Thank you. And would you mind telling me what you do?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: So was the reason for your visit here today work?

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: Actually, it's my day off. I came here to do some shopping.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: OK. Now I'd like to ask some questions about your journey today, if that's OK.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Right, so can you tell me which station you're travelling back to?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Can I just check the spelling? S-T-A-U-N-F-I-R-T-H?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: OK, good. Next, can I ask what kind of ticket you bought?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I assume it wasn't a season ticket, as you don't travel every day.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: That's right. No, I just got a normal return ticket.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: I don't have a rail card so I didn't get any discount.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: I keep meaning to get one because it's a lot cheaper.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes – you'd have saved 20% on your ticket today.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: So you paid the full price for your ticket?

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: Not really. I think it's too much for a journey that only takes 45 minutes.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, that's one of the main complaints we get. So, you didn't buy your ticket in advance?

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: No. I know it's cheaper if you buy a week in advance but I didn't know I was coming then.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I know. You can't always plan ahead. So, did you buy it this morning?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Right. And do you usually buy your tickets at the station?

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: Well, I do usually but the ticket office closes early and I hate using ticket machines.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: I think ticket offices should be open for longer hours.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: There's always a queue for the machines and they're often out of order.

cues.speaker: IE
cues.text: So to answer your question ... I got an e-ticket online.
